about_short_description.short_description: Get matched with the top 1% of talent and get results in 24 hours.

product.name: 1 to 1 Talent Plan
product.description: A full-time engagement service matching clients with vetted product designers and developers to build products from scratch with daily updates and direct collaboration.

product.name: Pro Plan
product.description: A subscription-based service providing access to vetted designers and developers for tasks like landing pages, branding, and marketing materials with daily updates and AI matching.

product.name: Freelance Designer Hiring Service
product.description: A service that matches companies with freelance designers across specialties like graphic, UI/UX, marketing, and logo design, providing vetted talent and streamlined hiring.

product.name: AI-Enabled Talent Matching
product.description: An AI-driven algorithm that matches clients with the top 1% of vetted designers and developers suited to their project needs within 24 hours.

product.name: Design and Development Services
product.description: A range of design and development services including UI/UX design, branding, graphic design, motion graphics, no-code development, and webflow implementation.
